items.q: How do I choose the best WhatsApp API service provider in Tamil Nadu?
items.a: Look past the rate. Check that the provider is an official Meta partner, helps you get templates approved in both Tamil and English, shows per-message delivery reports with reasons, itemises Meta's charges and its own, and has support you can reach. Run a small test campaign before you commit volume.

items.q: Can I send WhatsApp templates in Tamil?
items.a: Yes. Tamil is on Meta's list of supported template languages. Each template is created and reviewed in a single language, and Meta does not translate it for you, so submit separate Tamil and English versions and send each customer the language they prefer.

items.q: Do I need a WhatsApp API provider based in Tamil Nadu?
items.a: No. The WhatsApp Business Platform is accessed online, and onboarding, templates and support do not depend on where your provider's office is. What matters is official Meta access, template support in your language, reliable reports and a team you can reach during your business hours.

items.q: Does the WhatsApp API cost more in Tamil Nadu than elsewhere in India?
items.a: No. Meta bills per delivered message by message category and the recipient's country, not by state. Check Meta's official pricing page for current rates, and ask any provider for an itemised quote that separates Meta's charges from platform fees and says whether GST is included.

items.q: Can manufacturers and exporters use the WhatsApp API for dealers and buyers?
items.a: Yes, for opted-in contacts. Typical uses include order and dispatch updates, payment reminders, quotation follow-ups and sample or shipment status. Use utility templates for transactions and marketing templates only for promotions, and keep a clear way for contacts to opt out.

items.q: How should I plan WhatsApp campaigns around Pongal and Deepavali?
items.a: Submit your templates well before the season so approval is not a bottleneck, build your opt-in list early, segment by customer interest, and pace your sends. Meta can limit how many marketing messages one person receives from all businesses, so avoid sending the same customer several offers a day.

items.q: Does the WhatsApp API need DLT registration?
items.a: No. DLT registration under TRAI's rules applies to SMS. WhatsApp follows Meta's template approval and opt-in policies. If you add an SMS fallback, that SMS still needs your DLT entity, sender ID and approved template.

items.q: Is bulk WhatsApp messaging allowed in India?
items.a: Sending through the official WhatsApp Business Platform to customers who opted in is permitted by WhatsApp's policy. WhatsApp's own FAQ says its apps are not meant for bulk or automated messaging. You must also follow Indian law, including the DPDP Act's principles. This is practical guidance rather than legal advice.
